name: Domestika OG social card — white wordmark on flat red field by domestika.org
description: A single-element social card: a full-bleed flat red-orange field (~#F02A10) with nothing but the white DOMÉSTIKA wordmark, optically centred on the 1200×630 canvas. Roughly 85% of the surface is empty colour, so the heavy geometric sans wordmark — whose accented É is doubled by the brand's chevron glyph — carries all focal weight. The restraint works because contrast does everything: one saturated hue, one pure-white wordmark at ~55% of canvas width, no tagline, URL, imagery or second colour to dilute recognition in a small link preview.
